2187-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2187-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-856-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 4, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

147-8095-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-8095-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-585-3480-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1724-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
The amount of +1/+1 counters on Sekki plus the number of other Spirits you control is at least eight.
1724-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature, targeting Sekki. Sekki will prevent the 1 damage that would be dealt to it and instead removes a +1/+1 counter from it and creates a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Repeat step 1 until Sekki dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
2557-4094-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

301-7096-7860.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
301-7096-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

4682-5140-6441-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-5140-6441-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-5140-6441-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1580-2292-4871-7316.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-6478-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-7296.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-7704.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4120-7704.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4120-7704.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
2292-6972-7230.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2061-4377-6991.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-6797-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

856-997-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

957-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
957-3976.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Time Stretch and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your second extra turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Time Stretch without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

880-2783-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2783-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3586-4055-4222.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

2034-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

3129-4094-4636-5770.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3129-4094-4636-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-4535-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
618-4535-4613.description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Widespread Thieving

947-1132-1305-2210.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving and Mirrormade trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

803-4338-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1263-3602-4050-4929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and goading it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2232-2459-2757-3474.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Rograkh, untapping a basic Forest.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

500-2021-2557-4751.notablePrerequisites: Simic Ascendancy has at least four growth counters on it.
500-2021-2557-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve a Verdurous Gearhulk trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting four growth counters on itself.
Repeat steps 3-4 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1437-4604.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-4604.description:
Cast Kiora's Dambreaker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Kiora's Dambreaker spell three times.
Resolve the first Kiora's Dambreaker spell.
When the Kiora's Dambreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-4604.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Kiora's Dambreaker spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.
